svg.title: TESS CNN Audio Emotion Recognition — Full Pipeline Diagram
svg.desc: Complete pipeline from raw WAV files through audio preprocessing, Mel spectrogram feature extraction, CNN model, training loop, and evaluation.

g.text: os.walk → parse filename → extract: speaker, word, emotion, file_size, duration, sr
RMS energy · Zero-crossing rate · Spectral centroid · Duration stats per emotion
LabelEncoder → y (int) · 7 classes: angry disgust fear happy neutral pleasant_surprise sad
one Mel spectrogram image with 1 channel
Block 1 — Conv2D(32, 3×3, relu) + BatchNorm + MaxPool(2×2) + Dropout(0.35)
output (None, 64, 65, 32) · learns simple frequency-time edge patterns
Block 2 — Conv2D(64, 3×3, relu) + BatchNorm + MaxPool(2×2) + Dropout(0.35)
output (None, 32, 32, 64) · learns combined vocal texture patterns
Block 3 — Conv2D(128, 3×3, relu) + BatchNorm + MaxPool(2×2) + Dropout(0.35)
output (None, 16, 16, 128) · learns high-level emotion feature maps
probability for each of 7 emotions · shape (None, 7)
Training loop — 4 hyperparameter trials · max 50 epochs

svg.text: Best trial: lr=0.001, dropout=0.25, bs=16, size=medium → val_acc=1.00
+ t-SNE embedding plot from "embedding" layer · SHAP-style per-class analysis
